<thought>We need the SMILES of the unknown compound. The only way to get structural information is to retrieve experimental data (e.g., NMR, MS) using the provided tools. We'll start by obtaining the mass spectrum to get the molecular weight, then acquire the 1H NMR spectrum to infer functional groups, and finally the 13C NMR spectrum. This stepwise approach minimizes the number of tool calls while gathering enough information to deduce the structure.</thought>
